'''Herrik's sun''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Herrik system/Legends|Herrik system]] that was orbited by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herrik]]. The star emitted a unique form of stellar interference that caused malfunctions in equipment and [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
